# Per location: our strength there, the strongest other power's, and the
# inbound record (as the Solar System rows).
sr_disp_loc_ours_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_at_earth } value = var:sr_fl_at_earth }
}
sr_disp_loc_others_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_strength_earth } value = global_var:sr_loc_strength_earth subtract = sr_disp_loc_ours_earth }
	min = 0
}
sr_disp_loc_flag_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ls_cap_earth sr_disp_loc_others_earth > 0 } value = 1 }
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_earth } value = global_var:sr_loc_inbound_earth }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_inbound_first_earth } value = global_var:sr_loc_inbound_first_earth subtract = te_history_month_index }
	min = 0
}

# Per location, the viewer's status there (6b): 1 a battle this month or last,
# 2 a colony of ours blockaded, 3 an enemy's blockaded by us; 6c: 4 a colony of
# ours interdicted (blockaded by a country at peace with us), 5 we interdict.
sr_disp_loc_status_earth = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_battle_earth global_var:sr_loc_battle_earth >= { value = te_history_month_index subtract = 1 } } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_loc_status_inner = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_loc_battle_inner global_var:sr_loc_battle_inner >= { value = te_history_month_index subtract = 1 } } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_venus NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_venus } } AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_mercury NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_mercury } } } } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_venus } AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_mercury } } } value = 4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_at_inner OR = { AND = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_venus global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= { has_war_with = prev } } AND = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_mercury global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= { has_war_with = prev } } } } value = 3 }

# Colony Defences (6b), per world: 1 while ours (or ours occupied), its integrity
# whole, its status (0 calm, 1 blockaded, 2 under assault, 3 occupied, 4
# interdicted, 6c), and
# 1 while its occupier's capital snapshot is there to show.
sr_disp_def_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_def_integrity_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_integrity_value_valles_marineris floor = yes }
sr_disp_def_status_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris } value = 3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_under_assault_valles_marineris global_var:sr_site_under_assault_valles_marineris >= { value = te_history_month_index subtract = 1 } } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_valles_marineris } value = 4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_valles_marineris } value = 1 }
}
sr_disp_def_occupier_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris has_variable = sr_ss_occ_valles_marineris } value = 1 }
}

	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_under_assault_pluto global_var:sr_site_under_assault_pluto >= { value = te_history_month_index subtract = 1 } } value = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_pluto } value = 4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_pluto } value = 1 }
}

sr_disp_fl_2_tgt_def_low = {
	value = sr_disp_fl_2_tgt_def
	if = { limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_2_target_known = yes } } subtract = 1 }
	min = 0
}
sr_disp_fl_2_tgt_def_high = {
	value = sr_disp_fl_2_tgt_def
	if = { limit = { NOT = { sr_fl_2_target_known = yes } } add = 1 }
}
